jobs.description:
Requisition ID \# 174549
  
  

**Job Category:** Human Resources
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Enterprise Transformation
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

PG\&E Academy is looking for an Instructional Designer to join our PG\&E Academy Curriculum Development Team in support of Gas Operations learning needs. This role works closely with the development team and clients to develop and maintain the learning content, tools, systems, and programs that support our employee’s ability to safely and efficiently perform their work and job tasks. This is accomplished via a wide range of methodologies, delivery mechanisms and formats to meet specific business needs. The Instructional Designer will work closely with subject matter experts as well as internal and external stakeholders to translate business and performance objectives into learning and performance support solutions and to ensure that employees are trained to competence.
  
  

Propel is a business and technology modernization program that will revolutionize PG\&E’s way of working. Propel will standardize our business processes, enable innovation and unlock value across our core business functions as we move to a new version of SAP.
  
  

Elevate is PG\&E’s enterprise\-wide program to modernize and standardize our GIS platforms. GIS\-based technology is critical to PG\&E’s operations, supporting infrastructure and planning, emergency response and asset management. Elevate brings together electric, gas, power generation, land and telecom mapping systems into one connected network using Esri’s Utility Network (UN) technology.
  
  

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and the Oakland General Office three times a week, or based on business need.
  
  

Job Responsibilities
  
Apply specialized discipline in learning theory or technology to lead and implement initiatives that have impact beyond a single training project or program. Utilize benchmarking data, industry standards and best practices to provide guidance on and execution of programmatic learning and performance support solutions. Work with managers and directors across functions to lead the design and production of complex, cross\-functional learning and performance support projects that require measuring job performance impact, business results and return on investment. Develop new and innovative training tools, methods, approaches and tactics or leading initiatives that build internal capabilities that drive innovation. Create instructional frameworks to support the development and execution of large\-scale training programs. Coach, mentor and train other team members. Manage multiple priorities to deliver the solution on time, on target and on budget and align with change management adoption targets.
  
  

Background Qualifications
  
  

Minimum
  
A Bachelor's Degree in Instructional Design, Liberal Arts or related degree / field or equivalent work experience. 7 or more years of Instructional Design or Communications or Teaching or Training or Change Management, or Graphic Design work experience required. Progressive responsibility in an advanced instructional design capacity with skills and experience in designing and developing curriculum for large complex cross functional projects. Experience working on mid to large\-size projects and/or training programs. Experience working with management to create learning solutions.
  
  

Desired
  
Master’s Degree preferred. eLearning, mLearning, and Virtual Learning design and development experience. Working knowledge of work methods and processes in the different work streams PG\&E is currently training on
  
  

Compensation
  
  

PG\&E provides the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed between the entry point and the middle of the range, the decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to these factors.​ This job is also eligible to participate in PG\&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.
  
  

**A reasonable salary range is:** ​
  
**Bay Area Minimum:** $118,000 Bay Area Midpoint: $153,000 Bay Area Maximum: $188,000

jobs.title: Sr. Cloud Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

  

  

As a Senior TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.  

  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
* 5\+ years of technical engineering experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Remote Home Health Interdisciplinary QA Specialist, Therapy \& MSW Documentation  
**Company:** Allegro Home Health  
**Location:** Remote  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Part\-Time, or Contract  
**Pay:** Competitive, based on experience

About Allegro Home Health

Allegro Home Health is a growing Medicare\-certified home health agency serving the San Francisco Bay Area. We are committed to delivering high\-quality patient care while maintaining strong Medicare compliance, clinical documentation integrity, and consistent support for our field clinicians.

We are seeking an experienced **Remote Home Health Interdisciplinary QA Specialist** with strong knowledge of home health documentation, Medicare requirements, therapy documentation, Medical Social Work documentation, OASIS, CMS 485 Plans of Care, and Kinnser/WellSky.

This is an individual contributor role, not a director\-level position. The focus is hands\-on quality assurance review, documentation feedback, and practical clinician education.

Position Summary

The Home Health Interdisciplinary QA Specialist will review clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, compliance, and consistency with Medicare home health requirements. This role will focus heavily on **Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Speech Therapy, Medical Social Work, CMS 485 Plans of Care, OASIS consistency, physician orders, visit frequencies, skilled need, homebound support, and interdisciplinary chart review**.

The ideal candidate understands how therapy and MSW documentation must support skilled need, medical necessity, homebound status, patient\-specific goals, care coordination, and Medicare billing compliance. This person should be able to identify documentation gaps and provide clear, practical feedback to clinicians without being overly rigid or unrealistic.

Experience with **Kinnser/WellSky** is strongly preferred.

Key ResponsibilitiesInterdisciplinary Clinical QA \& Chart Review

* Conduct QA reviews of patient records from admission through discharge.
* Review documentation from multiple home health disciplines, including:
* Physical Therapy
* Occupational Therapy
* Speech Therapy
* Medical Social Work
* Skilled Nursing
* Home Health Aides
* Ensure documentation is accurate, complete, cohesive, clinically appropriate, and compliant with Medicare home health requirements.
* Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance risks before billing submission.
* Ensure consistency among referral records, physician orders, OASIS assessments, CMS 485 Plans of Care, therapy evaluations, MSW evaluations, visit notes, reassessments, recertifications, and discharge documentation.
* Validate that documentation supports skilled need, medical necessity, homebound status, and continued eligibility for home health services.
* Provide clear, practical, and professional feedback to clinicians regarding documentation corrections and improvement opportunities.

PT, OT \& ST Documentation QA

* Review Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Speech Therapy evaluations, reassessments, progress notes, visit notes, and discharge documentation.
* Ensure therapy documentation supports Medicare coverage requirements and skilled intervention.
* Verify that therapy documentation clearly supports:
* Functional deficits
* Fall risk and safety concerns
* ADL and IADL limitations
* Gait, balance, strength, endurance, transfers, mobility, swallowing, communication, cognition, or safety needs as applicable
* Patient\-specific measurable goals
* Skilled interventions provided
* Treatment progression or clinical reason for lack of progress
* Caregiver training and response
* Continued skilled need
* Discharge readiness or need for continued services
* Review therapy frequencies and durations for clinical appropriateness and consistency with the CMS 485 Plan of Care.
* Review therapy recertification documentation to ensure continued skilled need and homebound status are clearly supported.
* Identify generic or weak therapy documentation and provide correction guidance that is practical for field clinicians.
* Support documentation improvement for maintenance therapy, functional decline, fall risk, caregiver training, and continued skilled need.

Medical Social Work Documentation QA

* Review Medical Social Work evaluations, visit notes, care coordination documentation, resource planning, and discharge documentation.
* Ensure MSW documentation supports the need for skilled social work intervention during the home health episode.
* Verify that MSW documentation clearly reflects:
* Psychosocial barriers affecting care
* Patient and caregiver support needs
* Community resource needs
* Safety concerns
* Financial, transportation, housing, food, medication access, or caregiving barriers when applicable
* Advance care planning, long\-term planning, or placement concerns when applicable
* Coordination with family, caregivers, community agencies, physicians, and the interdisciplinary team
* Patient/caregiver response to MSW intervention
* Clear plan for follow\-up or discharge from MSW services
* Ensure MSW services are connected to the patient’s home health Plan of Care and are not documented as generic social support only.
* Provide practical feedback to MSW clinicians on Medicare\-compliant documentation and patient\-specific care planning.

OASIS \& CMS 485 Plan of Care Review

* Review OASIS assessments for consistency with the clinical record, especially functional status, therapy needs, cognitive status, safety risk, caregiver support, and discharge status.
* Review CMS 485 Plans of Care for accuracy, completeness, clinical appropriateness, and Medicare compliance.
* Ensure the Plan of Care supports diagnoses, skilled services, visit frequencies, interventions, measurable goals, homebound status, and discharge planning.
* Ensure OASIS findings, therapy needs, nursing needs, MSW needs, physician orders, and the CMS 485 Plan of Care are consistent.

jobs.title: Operations Project Manager
jobs.description:
Think and Ink Grant Consulting® is seeking a detail\-oriented, proactive Operations Project Manager to serve as the firm's operational backbone on a part\-time basis, supporting the Founder \& CEO across Operations, People Operations (HR), and Get.Grants.Better.®. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, remote consulting environment and manages competing priorities with minimal oversight. This position reports to and is managed by the CEO.


### **About Think and Ink Grant Consulting**


Founded in 2016 in Atlanta, GA, Think and Ink Grant Consulting® provides customized, practical, and real\-world solutions to help nonprofit organizations “think” through effective grant\-seeking strategies and “ink” competitive proposals. We are proud to be home to really smart, driven, and passionate people whose life mission is to do good in the world. Yes, we think they are cool too. If this sounds like you, check out our employment opportunities below.
### **Description**

  

  

**Operations Project Manager (Part\-Time)**

**Start Date:** **October 1, 2026**
===================================

**Location:** Remote (Atlanta, GA Preferred)

**Job Type:** Part\-time, hourly (W\-2 employee)

**Level:** Mid\-level

**Focus:** Operations and People Operations

**Time Commitment:** 20 hours per week

**Hourly Rate:** $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

**Reports to:** CEO

**About Think and Ink Grants**
==============================

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Clinical Operations Specialist is an internal data and compliance analyst embedded within the Healthcare Center of Excellence (HCOE) Operations function at Strategic Education, Inc. This role serves as the primary owner of regulatory intelligence, state\-level approval tracking, accreditation data support, and operational reporting across all HCOE healthcare programs at Capella University and Strayer University.
   

Operating as a shared service, this role supports academic units at both institutions by maintaining the data infrastructure, dashboards, and reporting systems that enable the Assistant Dean for Operations, Executive Dean, Deans, program directors, accreditation leads, and senior leadership to make informed, timely decisions. This is a dedicated analytical and operational support position designed to reduce administrative burden on senior academic leaders while increasing the organization’s visibility into and responsiveness to regulatory change.
**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Regulatory Intelligence**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve a 50\-state regulatory monitoring system covering all applicable state\-level approval requirements for HCOE healthcare programs, including but not limited to: BSN Pre\-Licensure, Associate Degree Nursing (ADN), LPN, Radiologic Technology, Respiratory Therapy, and Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) programs.
* Attend regulatory agency hearings, public comment sessions, or stakeholder convenings as directed by the ADO; prepare pre\-meeting briefings and post\-meeting summaries.
* Maintain an ongoing regulatory change log and issue tracker with status, owner, deadline, and risk level for each open item across all program types.
* Track state\-specific application requirements, processing timelines, and approval status for all pending or in\-progress program expansions across the full HCOE portfolio.

**Dashboard Development \& Data Reporting**

* Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports that provide real\-time visibility into regulatory status, state approval progress, clinical placement data, and accreditation timelines across all HCOE programs.
* Develop and own program\-specific State Approval Trackers as living operational tools — updating status categories, notes, and risk flags on a defined cadence. Produce standardized and ad hoc reports for multiple stakeholder audiences, including the ADO, Dean, program directors, Legal/Risk, Portfolio Strategy, and C\-suite leadership
* Build and maintain a clinical placement data repository tracking site\-level affiliation agreement status clinical hours capacity, and geographic footprint across all programs.
* Develop reporting pipelines that integrate data from multiple sources (Smartsheet, SharePoint, OneDrive, external agency websites) into cohesive operational views.
* Ensure all dashboards and trackers include version control, data source citations, and last\-updated timestamps for audit readiness.

**Accreditation and Clinical Operations Data Support**

* Support the maintenance of an accreditation standards mapping library that cross\-references applicable standards to program\-level evidence, documentation, and responsible owners within the academic units.
* Support academic unit leads in maintaining accreditation cycle timelines, self\-study due dates, site visit windows, and annual report deadlines across all accredited HCOE programs.
* Assist in organizing and compiling supporting evidence and data sets required for accreditation reports, site visit preparation, and interim monitoring submissions as directed.
* Support the ADO and academic unit stakeholders in maintaining clear documentation distinguishing HCOE program\-level approval status from institutional\-level regulatory approval status across reporting contexts.
* Provide data and reporting infrastructure that enables academic units at Capella and Strayer to meet their respective accreditation reporting obligations with accurate, readily retrievable information.
* Develop and maintain a library of templated reports tailored to distinct stakeholder groups: operational summaries for the ADO, executive briefings for C\-suite, program\-level detail for directors, and compliance\-focused summaries for Legal/Risk.
* Prepare presentation\-ready data outputs (slides, formatted tables).

**Job Skills:**

* Consultation: Serve as a university consultant to internal and external partners by providing data ready reports, tools and trackers.
* Collaboration: Partner with university and system leaders to integrate academic priorities with institutional and system‑wide goals.
* Data Visualization: Translate complex regulatory and compliance data into clear, audience\-appropriate formats: executive summaries, status tables, heatmaps, gap analyses, and risk matrices.
* Synthesis of Data: Able to synthesize large inputs of data and turn into concise documents for a broad audience.
* Strong prioritizations skills that are able to balance competing high priority projects.
* High degree of self\-direction and comfort operating in a matrixed, remote\-first environment.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, particularly in regulatory tracking and compliance documentation.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to convey complex issues in a concise and clear manner.
* Displayed business acumen and enterprise awareness.

**Work Experience:**

* Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in a regulatory, compliance, accreditation, academic operations, or healthcare data analyst role required.
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards, trackers, or reporting tools strongly preferred (Excel, Smartsheet, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* Experience working in higher education, healthcare regulation, or a multi\-site/multi\-state compliance environment strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with nursing education and allied health regulatory frameworks, including state board of

CCS services include e\-Filing (electronic filing), order and referral management, insurance verifications, prior authorizations, and completing patient medical forms. * Perform other duties, as assigned, to ensure effective operation of the department and the Company


**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Experience with health information management concepts, EHRs and/or medical terminology is a plus
* Proficient in managing a high\-volume, fast\-paced environment with accuracy
* Intermediate computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to adapt to company\-specific software
* Capable of efficiently navigating multiple open programs, windows and applications
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Must be able to perform physical tasks such as sitting, talking, hearing, using hands, reaching, standing, walking, driving, and occasionally lifting up to 25 lbs

* Ability to fulfill responsibilities in a remote capacity while ensuring access to strong/reliable internet within a designated, secure and private workspace

jobs.description:
**Quality Assurance Representative**
Since our doors opened in 1989, Reliable Medical has been committed to improving the lives of all who entrust us with their care and those who we entrust to provide it. We strive to be the premier provider of complex mobility solutions and other critical services for customers seeking compassionate care and optimal outcomes. **Position Overview**
The Quality Assurance Representative plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy and completeness of documentation related to client orders and technician submissions. This position is responsible for reviewing incoming paperwork, identifying discrepancies, and confirming that clients receive the correct items and services. The role requires strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and effective communication across departments to support operational efficiency and service quality.

* Review and process technician submissions and client order documentation to verify accuracy and completeness
* Identify and resolve errors, inconsistencies, or missing information in submitted paperwork
* Communicate with internal teams to clarify documentation and ensure timely resolution of issues
* Provide guidance to field technicians regarding documentation requirements and corrections
* Maintain organized digital records and ensure daily closure of documentation workflows
* Monitor flagged submissions and coordinate follow\-up for items requiring additional review
* Collaborate on process improvements to enhance team efficiency and service delivery
* Support remote team operations through timely communication and responsiveness via internal messaging platforms
* Perform other duties as assigned by management

**Qualifications and requirements**
* High School diploma or equivalent
* Proficiency in computer systems and digital documentation tools Ability to navigate client management and inventory platforms
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


**Preferred*** Prior experience in office or administrative roles
* Background in healthcare, medical services, or durable medical equipment
* Advanced computer skills, including efficient typing and digital file management
* Familiarity with order processing workflows or quality assurance procedures


**Competencies and Skills**
* Attention To detail and analytical skills
* Quality Control and documentation. Accurately reviews documentation and identifies discrepancies or missing information
* Excellent communication and collaboration
* Critical Thinking: Investigates root causes of errors and applies sound judgement to resolves issues
* Time Management: Prioritizes tasks effectively and meets daily processing goals.
* Job Management Communication Skills: Clearly conveys information across teams and responds promptly via internal platforms.
* Technical Proficiency: Navigates client management and inventory systems with confidence.
* Adaptability: Adjusts to changing workflows, remote environments, and evolving documentation standards.
* Collaboration: Works constructively with technicians, leads, and cross\-functional teams
* Professionalism: Maintains a positive, ethical, and service oriented approach in all interactions.


**Physical Demands and Work Environment**
* Ability to work in a standard office environment.
* Ability to sit and stand for long periods of time while working on a computer or attending meetings.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 15 pounds occasionally (e.g., event materials or promotional items).


**Our Commitment to you:**
* **Work\-Life Balance and Flexibility:** Enjoy a guaranteed 40 hours per week, with no weekends required.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** We provide excellent health, dental, and vision insurance coverage to prioritize the well\-being of yourself and your family.
* **Generous Paid Time Off:** Maintain a healthy work\-life balance with our generous PTO policy, including vacation days and paid holidays.
* **Professional Development Opportunities:** Grow your skills and advance your career with access to professional development opportunities including education programs, ongoing training, company sponsored workshops/events.
* **Retirement Savings Plan:** Prepare for your future with our 401(k) retirement savings plan, which includes company matching contributions.
* **Wellness Programs:** Participate in our wellness initiatives, such as wellness challenges and access to mental health resources, to support your overall well\-being.
* **Inclusive and Diverse Workplace:** Be part of an inclusive team where everyone's contributions are valued and respected.
* **Volunteer Opportunities:** Additional paid time off to volunteer and support community initiatives. This benefit is known as “VTO – Volunteer Time Off”.
* **Employee Recognition Programs:** Awards and celebrations for outstanding achievements.
* **Service Awards:** Recognition for long\-term employees with milestone rewards.
* **Parental and Childbirth Leave:** Receive support and time off for parental and childbirth leave to prioritize family needs during significant life events.


At Reliable Medical, we prioritize your well\-being and growth,
providing benefits that make your career journey both rewarding and fulfilling.

jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start\-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.  

The Sr Customer Success Manager, Strategic Accounts supports, nurtures, and grows Bluesight's key customers. This individual is responsible for developing and executing a three\-year strategic model that supports the significant growth of Bluesight's key customer base, positions Bluesight as a long\-term, strategic partner, and fosters executive relationships with Bluesight’s key customers. This individual will work closely with Bluesight’s internal teams and largest customers to identify ways to sustain, improve, and create value with Bluesight’s solutions.

This position is a remote position and open to applicants in the continental United States.
### **Service Delivery Representative Responsibilities:**

* Manage pool of 10\-20 of Bluesight’s top strategic customers, maintain regular communication with customers to track progress and status, and facilitate executive relationship management
* Develop and maintain executive\-level relationships with customers, effectively working with C\-suite stakeholders to increase utilization and value of Bluesight applications, document and communicate ROI from Bluesight partnership, and drive additional revenue opportunities
* Conduct quarterly business reviews with executive\-level stakeholders of all assigned customers, and ensure all value assumptions remain valid and the relationship is producing outsized value
* Ability to educate customers on Bluesight's solutions, provide accurate and detailed consultative guidance on maximizing value, and lead process improvement initiatives with customers.
* Coordinate and define all activities needed to support key customers. This includes communicating in detail with internal teams, including Product, Support, and Marketing, as well as the Bluesight's executive team.
* Acquire and maintain customer references
* Gather, analyze, and clearly communicate relevant market intelligence to key customers, executive team, and other relevant internal stakeholders.


### **Representative Commercial Responsibilities:**

* Maintain 100%\+ net retention rates, reduce churn, and drive high volume of AMQLs to expand total contract value with customers through improved user adoption and ROI documentation.
* Meet and exceed upsell and cross\-sell lead generation quarterly goals.
* Influence future lifetime value through higher product adoption, user growth, customer satisfaction, documented ROI and overall health scores.
* Identify, develop, and execute a clearly defined 3\-year strategic model, supported by all teams and levels of Bluesight, that drives the greatest value, likelihood for renewal, and revenue expansion for top customers through increased utilization, new use cases or user groups, and upsell/cross sell of new Bluesight solutions
* Participate in regular renewal meetings with leadership, communicate pool health risks and trends across the cohort.
* Secure annual renewal and upgrade of membership contracts and corresponding service terms at a rate that meets or exceeds given performance goals: including renewal rates, price adherence, term length, etc.


### **Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related fields preferred.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience in strategic sales and account management, experience in healthcare preferred
* Experience selling SaaS and/or analytics platforms preferred.
* Ability to travel up to 15% of the time (travel is limited to US and Canada)
* Proven ability to meet goals and deadlines
* Proven negotiation skills
* Experience managing high\-profile clients
* Demonstrated ability to communicate and present credibly through email and phone with various stakeholders both internally and externally. Especially at the executive level
* Strong verbal and written communications skills
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of Salesforce, ChurnZero, and other pertinent business systems
* Well\-developed interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Strong customer services skills and commitment to meet or exceed customer expectations
* Experience with articulating value propositions and disseminating information effectively to external and internal stakeholders at all levels of an organization
* Excellent influencing and consultative selling skills and the ability to proactively identify and resolve barriers and challenges
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

The standard base pay range for this role is $100,000 to $115,000 annually. In addition to base salary this position is also eligible for commission/variable compensation based on achieving specified quotas/KPIs with the expected **OTR of $130,000 to $145,000 annually**. Actual amounts and salary will vary depending on the position offered, experience, performance, and location.**This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.**

**Why Bluesight?**
Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. * Fun, collaborative culture!

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision\-making in highly controlled regulatory environments.


As a Program Manager within Project Management, you will serve as a key connection between our clients and operational teams, overseeing the relationship and delivery health across portfolios of clinical studies. You will bring together the right expertise to manage risks, drive consistency, strengthen client partnerships, and support successful delivery across assigned accounts. If you thrive in a dynamic, client\-facing environment where you can take ownership, influence decisions, and navigate complexity, we’d love to hear from you.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Wellness programs and Employee Assistance Program
* Flexible remote work options

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Oversee delivery health across one or more assigned client portfolios, maintaining visibility across multiple clinical studies and ensuring consistent execution against client expectations.
* Build trusted client relationships, understand priorities and challenges, and translate client needs into clear actions for Project Management teams, operational teams, and subject matter experts.
* Identify portfolio\-level delivery risks, manage escalations, drive timely resolution, and proactively address issues that could affect client satisfaction, revenue, or future opportunities.
* Monitor study timelines, financial performance, operational KPIs, and agreed processes across assigned accounts, using insights to support governance discussions and continuous improvement.
* Partner across the broader account team, including Business Development and Client Success, to support a consistent client experience, account strategy, retention, and long\-term growth.
* Prepare for and participate in client governance and operational meetings, communicating effectively with stakeholders and providing clear recommendations and direction.

**What We Look For**
--------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Project Manager - Hevesh5, Inc
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Hevesh5, Inc. is a creator\-owned company led by Domino Artist Lily Hevesh (), whose YouTube channel has over 4\.6 million subscribers and 2 billion views.

We’re working to grow Domino Art as an art form and make it easier for people to discover, build, and participate in the domino community. Through online content, our product line of “H5 Domino Creations,” domino clubs, events, and educational programs, we’re building a hub for all things dominoes, and exploring new ways to bring Domino Art into schools, museums, libraries, brands, and other spaces.

We’re looking for an experienced business operations and project manager to help run and grow the company. This is a hands\-on, fast\-paced role with a great deal of independence and responsibility.

**What I’m Looking For**

I’m looking for someone who can create organization from chaos and manage multiple projects without needing constant direction. I have lots of ideas, but only a finite amount of time and bandwidth. I need someone who can quickly determine which ideas are worth pursuing (while keeping the bigger picture in mind), someone who knows when to say yes, and just as importantly, when to say no. I’m looking for someone who can take a half\-baked idea, or inherit a project, take ownership of it, figure out what needs to happen, and steer it through to completion.

The ideal candidate stays on top of communication, keeps opportunities from falling through the cracks, and can recognize when I’m becoming a bottleneck. You should be comfortable working directly with a founder, pushing back when necessary, asking for what you need, and keeping things moving when my attention is elsewhere.

**This is not an assistant role.** I’m looking for an ambitious, entrepreneurial\-minded person who wants to take real ownership, improve how the company operates, and help bring Domino Art into new territory.

**What You’ll Do**

**Business Operations**

* Manage incoming inquiries, opportunities, invoices, payments, budgets, and expenses
* Improve internal systems and processes
* Prioritize opportunities, help determine which are worth pursuing, and make them come to life

**Project Management \& Business Development**

* Take projects from initial inquiry through completion
* Manage client/agency communication, proposals, quotes, timelines, and deliverables
* Develop new opportunities with brands, agencies, museums, schools, libraries, and other organizations
* Pursue opportunities in sponsored content, custom Domino Art, workshops, tours, events
* Coordinate the Hevesh5 Domino Agency and subcontractors

**Contracts \& Negotiation**

* Review agreements for key business terms and potential concerns
* Negotiate commercial terms with clients, agencies, vendors, and partners
* Coordinate with attorneys when legal review is needed

**Events \& Logistics**

* Organize events, workshops, live shows, etc.
* Coordinate travel, venues, shipping, materials, schedules, participants, and vendors
* Manage event logistics and budgets from planning through completion

**Why Work for Hevesh5?**

* Help trailblaze an emerging art form and shape the future of Domino Art.
* Work on unique, high\-profile projects combining art, creativity, engineering, and entertainment.
* Opportunity to travel for industry conferences, events you help organize, and unique Domino Art builds around the world.
* Meet and collaborate with interesting people and organizations, from major brands, creators, and celebrities to museums, schools, and other institutions.
* Help build something from the ground up, developing systems and initiatives as the company grows beyond YouTube.
* Take real ownership in a role where your ideas and decisions can directly shape the company.

**Requirements**

* 4\+ years of experience in business operations, business management, project management, or a related role
* Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
* Comfortable making independent decisions with minimal direction
* Highly proactive and resourceful
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

**Preferred**

* Based in the Greater Boston area or within reasonable commuting distance. The role is primarily remote, but being local is a plus because of our physical studio, live events, and local projects.
* Experience in startup or small\-business operations, or working directly with a founder/executive
* Experience with creators, YouTube productions, agencies, or media companies
* Familiarity with sponsorships and brand partnerships
* Interest in STEAM, education, kids/families, or community building

**To apply, visit** **Hevesh5\.com/jobapplication**

Include a 2\-5 minute video explaining why you’re interested in this role, briefly highlighting your most relevant experience, and describing one project or initiative you independently took from idea to completion. No need for anything highly produced \- we’re more interested in hearing how you think, communicate, and take ownership.

Thanks for your interest and we look forward to hearing from you!

Learn more about our work at **Hevesh5\.com**.

Pay: $35,000\.00 \- $48,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

This position will oversee the full ServiceNow delivery lifecycle, from demand intake and project planning through Agile development, testing, release management, platform upgrades, production deployment, and operational transition.

  

The successful candidate will combine strong IT project management experience with hands\-on ServiceNow knowledge. You will coordinate technical teams and business stakeholders, manage complex project dependencies, maintain visibility into risks and deliverables, and help ensure ServiceNow initiatives are delivered successfully from initial requirements through production.

**What You Will Do in This Role**


The ServiceNow Project Manager will lead and coordinate ServiceNow projects and development initiatives, ensuring technical workstreams remain aligned with approved requirements, schedules, milestones, quality standards, and customer expectations.


Responsibilities include:

* Lead the planning, coordination, governance, and delivery of ServiceNow projects and development initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, resource assignments, deliverables, acceptance activities, and deployment plans.
* Maintain visibility into project scope, schedules, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, changes, testing, releases, deliverables, and milestones.
* Coordinate ServiceNow architects, developers, implementation specialists, administrators, business analysts, testers, cybersecurity personnel, business owners, and other stakeholders.
* Manage ServiceNow demand intake, evaluation, prioritization, approval, and conversion into projects or development activities.
* Use ServiceNow capabilities, including Demand Management, Strategic Portfolio Management/Project Portfolio Management (SPM/PPM), and Agile Development, to track and manage project activities.
* Ensure projects, epics, features, user stories, tasks, defects, risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, changes, and milestones are appropriately documented and maintained.
* Establish traceability between approved requirements, user stories, development activities, testing, releases, and project deliverables.
* Coordinate testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities as appropriate.
* Coordinate technical activities to ensure work is properly scheduled, documented, tested, approved, and delivered in accordance with project and platform requirements.
* Partner with ServiceNow platform and technical leadership to ensure project management and governance processes align with approved technical architecture, platform standards, and customer requirements.
* Plan and coordinate ServiceNow releases, production deployments, change\-management activities, and platform upgrades.
* Identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and changes while providing timely escalation when necessary.
* Provide project status reporting and communicate progress, risks, milestones, and delivery concerns to customer and organizational leadership.
* Ensure technical workstreams operate as an integrated project and satisfy approved requirements, milestones, deliverables, quality requirements, and acceptance criteria.

**What You Will Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 8\+ years of experience supporting or managing large\-scale IT projects.
* At least 2 years of experience leading project teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects or development initiatives involving the ServiceNow platform.
* Hands\-on experience using ServiceNow to manage project workflows, track tasks and deliverables, maintain project records, and produce status reports.
* Experience working within Agile development environments and using Agile methodologies and tools to track progress and manage timelines.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure and governance principles.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams and managing dependencies across multiple technical workstreams.
* Strong project planning, organization, risk management, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, customers, and leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), ITIL, or comparable project or service\-management certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM/PPM), Demand Management, or Agile Development capabilities.
* Experience coordinating ServiceNow platform upgrades, releases, change management, and production deployments.
* Experience supporting complex enterprise, government, or other highly structured IT environments.

We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.



Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.


**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Why this role is on the menu**
--------------------------------



The Customer Experience (CX) organization at Instacart is focused on making every interaction effortless, empathetic, and effective for our customers, shoppers, and partners. Our Knowledge team, spanning Knowledge Strategy, Content Operations, and Learning \& Development, designs the programs, processes, and content that enable CX teams to deliver consistently excellent support at scale.



We are looking for a **Knowledge Program Manager** who will support the planning, coordination, and execution of programs across our unified Knowledge function. In this role, you will work alongside Program Managers and cross\-functional stakeholders like CX Leaders, Operations, Quality, and Vendors to keep programs moving, track deliverables, manage intake and prioritization workflows, and ensure cross\-functional partners stay aligned. You will thrive in this role if you are highly organized, comfortable in a fast\-moving environment, and energized by connecting the dots between multiple workstreams to drive progress on things that matter.

  


**What you'll cook up in your first year**

* Support the end\-to\-end execution of knowledge and learning programs (e.g., onboarding, upskilling, content launches, process rollouts) by managing timelines, tracking milestones, and coordinating across stakeholders.
* Manage and maintain program operating rhythms — including Jira intake boards, sprint tracking, launch calendars, and stakeholder communications — to keep work visible and on track.
* Serve as a point of contact for cross\-functional partners submitting requests, triaging incoming work through the intake process and routing to the right function (Knowledge Strategy, Content Operations, or Learning \& Development).
* Partner with subject matter experts, instructional designers, and knowledge strategists to gather inputs, track dependencies, and flag risks before they become blockers.
* Draft and distribute program communications, status updates, and launch readiness materials for internal stakeholders and CX leaders.
* Use program data — sprint velocity, backlog health, completion rates, and stakeholder feedback — to surface trends, report on program health, and support continuous improvement.

  


**The secret ingredients we're looking for**

You will not own the client relationship or service strategy. Instead, you will create operational discipline around those functions, making sure decisions turn into action, risks surface early, and commitments remain realistic.

* Regularly review assigned projects to identify overdue work, adjust dependencies, resolve capacity concerns, and protect delivery timelines.

$114,750 \- $155,250



This salary range is offered with the understanding that final compensation is based on a number of factors including geography and experience. Tendo also offers an equity package, annual bonuses, and benefits.

  


**Benefits**



For full time employees, Tendo also offers full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending and health savings accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short\-term and long\-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k), company paid holidays, flexible time off, and an employee wellness program (“Breathe”).

**ABOUT BROADVOICE**


At Broadvoice, we believe that exceptional customer experience is the cornerstone of business success. Our AI\-powered contact center and communications solutions are designed to help mid\-market businesses simplify service, enhance satisfaction, and swiftly resolve issues.


Our holistic approach to CX sets us apart in the market. We don't just provide software. We offer a proven CX framework backed by hands\-on support. And our platform was built to be easy to deploy, intuitive to use, and scalable without chaos.


Every role in our company contributes to our mission of providing and creating exceptional experiences. Whether you're in product, sales, support, marketing, or operations, your work directly impacts our customers and, by extension, their customers. Collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence define our culture.

 **POSITION SUMMARY**


We are seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented Manager, Program Management Office (PMO) to establish and lead our program management function. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to build the PMO as a one\-person office initially, with potential to scale as our organization grows. In this role, you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and cross\-functional leaders to drive alignment, ensure delivery discipline, and bring visibility to key initiatives across our UCaaS and CCaaS portfolio.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Establish the PMO function, defining lightweight processes and governance tailored to an agile SaaS delivery model.
* Partner with product, engineering, and business leaders to plan, track, and report on key initiatives across UCaaS and CCaaS product lines.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, status reporting, and program metrics to ensure visibility for leadership.
* Facilitate cross\-team alignment, identifying and resolving delivery risks and dependencies.
* Support quarterly and monthly planning cadences, ensuring priorities and resourcing are aligned.
* Drive consistency in program execution without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Serve as the single point of contact for program and portfolio reporting, scaling the function over time as needed.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's degree or PMP certification a plus).
* 5\+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 3 years in a SaaS or cloud\-based technology company.
* Demonstrated ability to be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and effective at managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Familiarity with agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe) and experience adapting governance to agile environments.
* Experience managing programs in UCaaS, CCaaS, or related communications technology preferred.
* Self\-starter comfortable operating as a one\-person PMO, building structure from the ground up.
* Proficiency with program tracking tools (Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar).

 **WHY BROADVOICE**


We're not just building communication tools, we're creating the future of connection. And we need people who want to build it with us.

 **Own Your Growth**  

No cookie\-cutter career paths here. Sharpen your technical edge, step into leadership, or chart a course you haven't even mapped yet. You'll get real mentorship, real resources, and the autonomy to own your outcomes.

 **A Team Built Different**  

Diverse. Inclusive. Real. This is a culture that invests in people, not just performance metrics. You'll be surrounded by people who've got your back and push you to do better work.

 **Impact You Can Point To**  

Your ideas won't get lost in the shuffle. You'll have the backing of a product that competes well, and a direct hand in transforming Broadvoice into a CX powerhouse in the channel.

  

Ready to help us bring our story to life?

  

If you're a strategic thinker who thrives on collaboration and turns ideas into results, we want to meet you. Apply now and lead the charge with us.

 *Broadvoice is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. Reasonable accommodation will be made as needed for individuals with disabilities.*

============================


PSE Healthy Energy (PSE) is an independent science and policy research institute dedicated to generating science\-based energy and climate solutions that protect public health and the environment. Our multidisciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and public health professionals conducts research and actionable work across five key practice areas: Clean Energy Transition, Environmental Public Health, Climate, Energy Equity, and Oil and Gas. We design our research around real\-world challenges, proactively connecting our audiences with actionable, evidence\-based information they can trust.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and mission\-driven individual to join our team as a Project Coordinator. As a Project Coordinator, you will collaborate closely with Senior Project Managers, scientific research leads, and project teams to support various aspects of project execution, including conducting detailed planning during project initiation, tracking progress and key performance indicators across the project lifecycle, and ensuring activities align with organizational and project objectives. jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Form Health** is a national telemedicine weight loss clinic specialized in helping patients with obesity lose weight and lead healthier lives. Obesity impacts more than 40% of the US adult population, but only about 1% of patients receive medical treatment for their disease. The field of Obesity Medicine is entering a period of rapid growth that will see treatment rates surge. Today, Form Health can harness this growth to drive patient impact nationwide. We do this by making research\-based treatment available to patients through the convenience of telehealth, including long\-term care from a specialized physician and dietitian and FDA\-approved medication when appropriate. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect.



Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture\-backed startup with an experienced clinical team. Form Health's mission is to empower patients and be the leader in obesity medicine using personalized, research\-based treatment delivered through modern technology. The Patient Care Coordinator role supports physicians, dietitians and patients and is critical to our company mission of outstanding clinical care.


**About the role:**



Form Health's Patient Care Coordinators (PCCs) provide comprehensive support for daily clinical operations, ensuring our patients have a smooth, caring, and well\-organized experience from their very first interaction. Working collaboratively with medical clinicians and registered dietitians, PCCs support processes that enable excellent patient care. This includes a wide range of tasks from managing the patient's care team experience, coordinating patient scheduling, and assisting with benefits coordination, to answering questions regarding prescription fulfillment, and coordinating with external providers. PCCs will also provide essential support to clinicians by managing pre\-visit lab work and inputting vital sign and medical record documentation. We are passionate about helping people improve their health through weight loss and will provide you opportunities for learning and professional growth. This role is 100% remote.


**Where You'll Deliver Impact:**



We seek an experienced Medical Assistant, a collaborative team player with exceptional interpersonal and organizational skills, who is passionate about being part of a healthcare team and excited to work in a non\-traditional telemedicine practice environment. Ultimately, your role is about being organized, thoughtful, and empathetic, making sure every patient feels personally supported at every step of their journey.


**Key responsibilities include:**


**Care Team Management:**


* Acting as the primary point of contact to maintain communication flow between patients and their care team.
* Receiving, triaging, and resolving incoming clinical messages from patients to clinicians, and relaying messages from clinicians to patients as requested.
* Conducting regular outgoing patient communications to ensure consistent engagement and optimize their success in the program.
* Providing routine administrative support for clinicians
* Contributing to special projects as directed, helping to improve our systems and make care more efficient and effective.


**Lab / Medical Records Support:**


* Helping collect medical records from primary care or other providers when needed.
* Requesting medical records.
* Reviewing patient uploaded medical records.
* Facilitating Medical Records \& Prescriptions, including sending lab requisitions.
* Assisting with prior authorization coordination and other prescription\-related tasks.
* Assisting with medication refills and pharmacy questions.
* Supporting medical clinicians with pre\-visit lab orders.


**Membership / Program Status:**


* Guiding new patients through what to expect, both at the start and throughout their weight loss journey.
* Addressing general questions about the program.
* Supporting patients with account changes or cancellation requests.
* Providing feedback and communicating patient feedback to other company teams (i.e. Product, Engineering, Marketing) to improve operational tools and patient care.
* Assisting with clinical data collection as needed to track company's key clinical performance indicators or for quality improvement purposes.
* Providing scheduling and appointment support for patients.


**Billing / Insurance:**


* Assisting with general insurance and billing questions.
* Providing information regarding insurance coverage updates.
* Addressing billing concerns and coordinating with the billing department.
* Answering membership change questions related to billing.
* Providing information on the cost of memberships.
* Answering eligibility questions.

* A Medical Assistant (MA) Certificate is required: **Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) from the American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)** *or* **Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) from the American Medical Technologists (AMT)** *or* **Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) from the National Healthcareer Association (NHA).**

**Company Overview**
Farmers Business Network, Inc. (FBN®) is a pioneering digital marketplace and farmer\-to\-farmer network dedicated to empowering family farmers globally while promoting sustainable agriculture. With over 117,000 members, FBN's Farmers First® promise unites growers and ranchers in their quest to maximize profitability and increase food production. FBN leverages data, AI and direct\-to\-farm delivery to simplify the agricultural supply chain, boosting convenience and transparency, reducing farm input costs, enhancing access to financing and services, and providing personalized farm insights. Its Gradable® joint\-venture helps thousands of farmers adopt and earn rewards for regenerative practices while simplifying the access of regenerative products for the world’s leading food companies and grain buyers.  

  

Gradable is hiring Sustainability Program Leads to join our team to enable farmers participating in programs. The primary regenerative practices our programs promote include conservation tillage, cover cropping, and precision nitrogen application. Environmental outcomes our programs strive for include increased nitrogen efficiency, reduced carbon emissions, soil carbon sequestration, reduced soil runoff, and enhanced water quality. Our sustainability programs are
successful when farmers can profitably integrate regenerative practices into their farm business.  

  

The primary responsibility of this role is to support farmers in understanding requirements, executing contracts, submitting data, and meeting quality control and quality assurance standards. This individual will work remotely and be responsible for outbound contact and support of farmers over phone, text, and email. A successful candidate works efficiently with a high attention to detail. You have experience with row crop agronomics and enjoy talking to farmers about their practices and farm business. You are professional and will communicate clearly with technical service providers and grain merchants at our partner commercial agriculture companies. You are interested in ecosystem service markets and expanding the use of regenerative practices.  

  

This is an opportunity to grow sustainability markets in agriculture from the ground up.

* Provide a great customer experience to farmers enrolled in a sustainability program. This includes farmer outreach via email, phone, and in\-person meetings, working with farmers to gather required farm information, and helping farmers understand the impact of sustainable agriculture.
* Work with Gradable partners (usually commercial grain buyers) to manage farmers in a region and ensure that sustainability programs succeed in your territory.
* Help farmers learn about Gradable and how our platform can support their farm.
* Work with Gradable's product and data science team to help guide the development of new tools that make sustainable agriculture more accessible to farmers.

Menards and Tractor Supply are the two largest accounts in it today, and they anchor a portfolio we expect you to broaden across the channel. You will be the headquarters contact those customers call, and the person who decides where the trade dollars go, what the line review deck argues, and how our broker partners spend their hours in store.


This is a small, fast\-moving company, which cuts both ways. There is no layer between you and the buyer, and no layer between your decisions and the P\&L — a call you make in March shows up in the numbers by June. If you want a seat where you can see your own fingerprints on the business, this is one. If you want a large support apparatus behind you, it is not.

**ABOUT EARTHKIND**


EarthKind makes plant\-based pest prevention products that work without the poisons and traps most households would rather not have in the house. Our Fresh Cab Botanical Rodent Repellent is the first and only EPA registered rodent repellent for indoor use, with over 60 million pouches sold in the last 15 years. We manufacture and distribute from our headquarters in Mooresville, NC.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

**Customer leadership and growth**

* Own the headquarter relationship for a portfolio of national and regional retail accounts across the farm, ranch, and hardware channel, anchored by Menards and Tractor Supply.
* Lead line reviews, category presentations, and annual negotiations, and secure incremental distribution, assortment, and velocity.
* Identify and pursue new retailers, channels, or partnerships that extend EarthKind's reach.

**Planning, forecasting, and customer P\&L**

* Build annual and quarterly customer plans tied to company revenue and margin objectives.
* Forecast by customer, category, and item, and partner with Demand Planning so the plan and the supply match.
* Manage a customer\-level P\&L, including trade funds, promotional spending, and program investment, and partner with Finance on pricing and trade architecture.

**Broker and field execution**

* Direct our broker partners and field selling resources against clear priorities, targets, and scorecards.
* Equip them with the tools, training, and updates they need to execute the customer plan at store level.

**Insights and selling tools**

* Turn POS and syndicated data into a category story a buyer will act on, not a data dump.
* Build and continuously sharpen customer\-facing presentations, sell sheets, and category reviews.
* Partner with Marketing to translate brand strategy into customer\-specific programs, including retailer .com content and retail media where it applies.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER TWELVE MONTHS**

* A signed joint business plan with each of your top customers, with agreed growth targets and a promotional calendar built against them.
* Expanded distribution — measured in items, doors, or both — at your anchor accounts, plus at least one new customer or channel in the pipeline.
* Trade and promotional spend you can defend line by line, with post\-event ROI analysis behind each program.
* A forecast that Operations and Supply Chain trust enough to build to.
* Broker partners running against a written scorecard, with clear priorities and a regular review cadence.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Required**

* 4\+ years in CPG sales, key account management, category management, or trade and sales analytics — or equivalent experience in an adjacent commercial role.
* Direct headquarters\-level selling experience with at least one national retailer. Tractor Supply, Menards, Ace, Do It Best, Home Depot, Lowe’s, Walmart, Target, Kroger, or similar all count.
* Has built and presented a joint business plan or annual line review to a national buyer and can walk us through how it landed.
* Has managed a trade or promotional budget and can explain how they measured whether it paid back.
* Works comfortably in POS and syndicated data, with the ability to pull out actionable insights and recommendations.
* Able to travel approximately 15%, including overnight customer and store visits.

**Preferred**

* Farm and ranch, hardware, or home improvement channel experience.
* Experience directing broker partners or an outsourced field sales organization.
* Omnichannel or e\-commerce experience — retailer .com, marketplace, or retail media networks.
* Fluency using AI tools to speed up analysis, deck building, and customer research.

*If you meet most of the required list but not every line, apply anyway and tell us how you would close the gap. We would rather read that than miss you.*

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* **Base salary:** $80,000 – $110,000 based on experience and location.
* **Annual bonus:** \~25% of base at target, tied to customer growth and profitability.
* **Health:** Medical, dental, and vision — EarthKind covers 100% of the employee premium.
* **Retirement:** 401(k) with a company match.
* **Travel:** Approximately 15%, including customer headquarters visits, retail store walks, and two to three industry trade shows a year.

* Conversations with cross\-functional partners in Marketing, Finance, and Operations.
* References and offer.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Assembly Software**


When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned\-up industry.

 **Vision Statement**


Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime.

 **Mission Statement**


Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers.

 **Core Values**

* We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency \+ feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth \+ learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions \+ work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative \+ open\-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer \+ our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service \+ add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity \+ Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.
  

There’s a reason our clients stay with Assembly — the platform works, and the people behind it genuinely care. But “staying” isn’t the same as “thriving,” and that’s where you come in.

  

We’re looking for an Account Manager who sees every customer relationship as a growth opportunity — someone who can identify where Deliverable AI fits, where expansion is possible, and where Assembly can go deeper. You’ll own the commercial expansion motion across a portfolio of law firm accounts in your regional territory, working alongside a CSM who keeps clients happy so you can focus on growing the relationship. Your territory is your franchise. Own it.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage a portfolio of existing law firm accounts, owning renewals, upsells, and expansion revenue
* Build multi\-threaded relationships across your accounts — from paralegals to managing partners
* Run strategic business reviews that go beyond usage dashboards to deliver real insights and uncover growth opportunities
* Partner with Customer Success to keep accounts healthy and intervene early when risk appears
* Forecast accurately and keep Salesforce tight — leadership counts on your data to plan

**What You Bring**

* 3\+ years in B2B SaaS account management or sales with a track record of hitting renewal and expansion targets
* A strategic, relationship\-driven approach — you think in terms of account plans, not just transactions
* Comfort navigating complex stakeholder maps and having commercial conversations at all levels
* CRM fluency and a data\-informed mindset
* Bonus: experience working with law firms or in the legal tech space

  

When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have a ton of questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:

  

I am tired of the daily grind of a commute, where are you located?

  

With the exception of scheduled visits to our Miami, FL office and scheduled video meetings, you get to work in the comfort of your own home in your PJs if you’d like!

  

What makes Assembly Software so special?


The people are the heart of our organization! Our passion for our products and our entrepreneurial spirit creates an energetic and fun work culture. Assembly Software is a SaaS organization and the leading provider of case management solutions and through our three brands, Needles, Needles Neos and TrialWorks, we have a rich multi\-decade history. Today we have assembled the largest user base in the industry, with over 2,500 law firm customers and more than 40,000 users. In 2017, the business was acquired by Ridge Road Partners – a group of long\-term focused, business builders – who are transforming the business into a dynamic, fast\-growth enterprise. Additionally, Assembly Software offers a competitive compensation package with uncapped commissions for our Account Executives, and built\-in accelerators.

  

What are the benefits like?


You will be able to elect from competitive health, dental, and vision benefits in addition to short and long term disability, and other supplemental insurance options. You will have 401k, flexible time off, paid parental leave, and an employee assistance program. We value our employees and reward and recognize your contributions.

 *Assembly Software provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

**About Lyra Health**
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence\-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer\-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer\-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life\-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI\-powered platform combining the highest\-quality care and technology solutions.  

  

**About the Role:**

Lyra Health is looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager I who is energized by engaging with customers, building relationships, and delivering results. You should be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and resourceful. This role will be a great fit for you if you are a doer, who is passionate about making a difference, comfortable with ambiguity, and is naturally collaborative. You will serve as a strategic lead for a curated portfolio of our largest, most complex global customers. In this high\-visibility role you will be partnering directly with senior benefits leaders and external benefits consultants to shape their workforce mental health strategy on a global scale. We are looking for an agile, operationally rigorous person who actively leverages modern technology and data tools to scale their impact, cut through ambiguity, and deliver a seamless experience for our strategic partners.

* Serve as the primary relationship owner for our Major/Key segment employer customers (30,000\+ lives), maintaining regular contact with the customers’ benefits team members and other key stakeholders
* Partner with marketing to develop and deliver engaging campaigns and workshops for your customers

* Collaborate internally with teams such as product, clinical, data science, legal, and others to effectively resolve customer requests and issues
* Contribute to product roadmap planning, providing an important customer and patient voice, and champion new product offerings with your customers
* Leave customers feeling supported and delighted after every interaction, such that they renew with Lyra each year

* Excellent communication skills\-both verbal and written, with an emphasis on quickly gaining trust
* Ability to innovate and creatively solve problems in a highly collaborative manner
* Strong project management skills and a demonstrated ability to work successfully on cross\-functional teams
* Ability to prioritize and balance multiple customers
