jobs.description:
Keeper is hiring a driven Enterprise Account Manager to join our high producing B2B sales division. This can be a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.



Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity companies and gain valuable skills while expanding and developing client relationships in this pivotal role!


**About Keeper**



Keeper Security is one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero\-knowledge and zero\-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI\-enabled, cloud\-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role\-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just\-in\-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

**About Rippling**

  

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**

  

The Customer Success team (Internally called: Technical Account Manager (TAM)) partners with our largest and most strategic accounts to understand their needs, demonstrate where Rippling can solve their business needs, and ensure retention of key accounts. TAMs own the key admin relationships and are responsible for turning customers into long\-term champions, developing account strategy, and providing enablement and optimization best practices, all while providing an impeccable customer experience along the way.

  

Leading this team will challenge your ability to context\-switch from high level customer strategy to tactical account level escalations to retention opportunities on a daily basis. The ideal candidate is a customer\-obsessed strategist, eager to build and mentor a team of incredible TAMs.

 **Please note:** Employees based in San Francisco Bay Area or New York City Metro will be required to go into office 1\-3 days a week depending on mileage to office.

 **What you will do**

* Manage a team of highly motivated, customer\-focused TAMs to ensure the overall health and satisfaction of strategic accounts in our broker partner channel
* + Thought partner with TAMs and build playbooks for effective customer strategy
	+ Develop senior\-level relationships with customers
	+ Serve as a point of escalation for team’s accounts
	+ Ensure the team is trained and confident in Rippling product capabilities
	+ Own ongoing TAM account assignments
	+ Participate in recruiting process, from sourcing to hire
	+ Drive customer adoption of key features and best practices
	+ Meet with team members weekly to stay close on updates for key accounts
	+ Performance manage to ensure your team’s success
* Partner cross\-functionally to advocate for your team’s customer and partner needs
* + Collaborate with Product to incorporate voice of the customer into Rippling’s roadmap
	+ Partner with other team leaders to ensure the customer is supported in times of escalation
	+ Partner with Support to mitigate escalations
	+ Collaborate with other team leaders to strategize on customer support for major lifecycle events
* Build TAM team processes and culture
* + Measure team impact and prioritize CX lifecycle events
	+ Constantly iterate and improve TAM workflows and optimize process inefficiencies
	+ Collaborate with leadership team on quarterly kickoffs, offsites, team building events, and more to foster a strong team culture

**What you will need**

* 5\+ years of SaaS experience in customer\-facing role
* 2\+ years of management experience; passion for supporting and guiding a team’s growth, career progress, and job performance
* Expertise in account management and customer success best practices
* Ruthless prioritization and time management
* Boundless energy to help your team and your customers...all with a “can\-do” attitude!
* Strong attention to detail and ability to solve complex, interdependent problems
* Flexibility to thrive in a fast paced organization with dynamic responsibilities
* Bonus: 1\+ years of experience in HR, Payroll or Insurance Brokerage

 **Additional Information**

  

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

jobs.title: Product Operations and Support Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About Aegis Ventures**


**Aegis Ventures** is a next\-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The Aegis platform brings together market\-shaping ideas, permanent growth capital, and ambitious individuals who are driven to solve major societal problems. Our companies use technology to transform healthcare by dramatically improving quality, access, and cost. Aegis creates new companies with substantial input from our Digital Consortium of a dozen leading health systems and other ecosystem partners. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.


### **About the Company**


**Optain** is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking software and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we detect and manage eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through the introduction of AI and machine learning technology in frontline care settings at an accessible price. This not only promotes greater access to care, but promises to reduce the strains of overburdened healthcare systems.



Originally founded in Australia in 2019, Optain seeks to commercialize the inventions of Professor Mingguang He, a preeminent clinician\-scientist and scholar in the field of ophthalmology. Optain has achieved regulatory approval and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, Europe, and more.



In 2025, Optain received US FDA clearance for its Resolve retinal camera. Optain also recently closed a Series A funding round led by Insight Partners with participation from seven leading U.S. health system investors, including Memorial Hermann Health System, Northwell Health, Novant Health, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and UPMC. These systems collectively deliver care to 28 million patients across 25 states and have begun deploying Optain's platform across their networks, rapidly accelerating the company's footprint and expanding screening access nationwide.


### **About the Job**



As the **Product Operations and Support Specialist**, you will be the escalation point for customers using Optain’s robotic retinal camera and supporting software. Because our product is a tightly integrated hardware\-software medical device deployed in live clinical settings, you will troubleshoot issues that span device hardware, image capture software, image quality, connectivity, EHR integrations, and downstream teleophthalmology grading workflows. In the U.S., Optain pairs its FDA\-cleared Resolve camera with rapid teleophthalmology grading; in international markets, Optain offers AI\-enabled Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) for screening common eye diseases and cardiovascular risk.



This is a high\-ownership, U.S.\-based remote role on a growing product team, reporting to the VP of Product. Beyond hands\-on Tier 2 support, issue investigation, and medical device complaint handling, you will enable our Customer Support team, feed real\-world signal back to the Product team, and own the internal operations, tooling, and projects that make the Product and Support teams more effective.


### **What You'll Do**


* Serve as Tier 2 support for customers who escalate device feedback, complaints, and semi\-technical product issues; reproducing, diagnosing, and resolving problems across the hardware\-software boundary, distinguishing camera or hardware faults from software, image\-quality, connectivity, EHR\-integration, or user technique issues.
* Capture, document, and route device feedback and complaints in line with Optain’s quality management system and applicable regulations (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR), recognizing when feedback may constitute a reportable complaint or potential adverse event and escalating appropriately to Quality and Regulatory.
* Support the Customer Success team with semi\-technical product and onboarding questions, acting as the bridge between front\-line CS and Engineering support. Contribute to knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and training resources that enable CS to resolve more issues independently.
* Own internal operations and projects for the product team, including specifying requirements for internal support tooling, improving support and complaint\-handling workflows, and coordinating cross\-functional projects from intake to delivery.
* Support Quality in tracking and analyzing support and complaint trends, translate recurring problems into prioritized product improvement recommendations, and serve as a voice of the customer within the product organization.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Customer Success to ensure issues are resolved quickly while meeting the documentation rigor required of a regulated medical device.

### **What You'll Need**


* 3\+ years in technical support, product support, application support, or product operations for software as a medical device (SaMD), or combined hardware software medical device product.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across hardware\-software boundaries, isolating whether a problem originates in a hardware device, software, image quality, connectivity, or user technique. Ability to reproduce issues occurring on equipment at a remote customer site.
* Familiarity working within a quality management system and complaint\-handling processes in a regulated environment (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR, ISO 13485, or EU MDR), including an understanding of when an issue may be a reportable complaint or adverse event.
* Strong written communication, with a track record of building knowledge base articles, runbooks, or training that enables less\-technical teammates to resolve issues independently. Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technic

jobs.title: Care Navigator (Washington- Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**About Nolia Health:**
=======================


Founded in Seattle, Washington, Nolia is a healthcare company dedicated to providing personalized, clinically\-supported, and virtual\-first services for older adults and their family caregivers or care partners. We understand that chronic and serious illnesses related to aging impact not only those diagnosed but also those who care for them. Nolia's mission is to elevate family caregiving as a central component of healthcare. Our goal is to transform the way caregiving is perceived and valued, ensuring that family caregivers have the resources, knowledge, and support they need so no one has to navigate this journey alone.


**Our Vision, Mission and Values are very important to us and can be found** **here.** (https://www.noliahealth.com/about\-us)


**Position Overview:**
======================


We are seeking a Care Navigator to join our expanding transdisciplinary team to support our patients and families affected by chronic conditions and serious illness related to aging. Centering on the needs and goals of the patient and the family caregiver, the Care Navigator helps guide our families through their unique journey by providing ongoing biopsychosocial support, personalized and culturally responsive care\-planning, connection to local community resources, advocacy within social and health systems, coordination with primary care and disease stage specific education.


The Care Navigator will provide high quality care virtually via telehealth to patients/families living in home settings. You will work closely with our clinical team, that includes MD, Neuropsychologists, Nurse Practitioners and Social Workers to provide ongoing case management type support that will evolve with the ever\-changing needs of our patients, and their caregivers.


Join us in redefining healthcare by ensuring our caregivers receive the comprehensive support they deserve. Together, we can create a more compassionate, accessible, equitable and effective care system.


**Primary Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to):**
--------------------------------------------------------------


* Participate as an active member of our transdisciplinary team
* Act as the primary point of contact for caregivers, families, support networks and those living with chronic conditions.
* Actively supports caregivers, families and those living with chronic conditions to enhance quality of life and ensure safety in the home.
* Conduct biopsychosocial assessments to identify strengths, goals, unmet health\-related social needs, safety concerns, and to gain a comprehensive understanding of where our patients and families are in their journey.
* Develop personalized, creative responsive care plans that align with our clients' values, cultural, emotional and spiritual needs.
* Provide disease and stage\-specific education, utilizing our extensive resource library.
* Refer and connect family caregivers, and patients, to community\- based services and supports.
* Communicate with the patient's primary care physician and other healthcare specialists to ensure continuity of care for our clients and patients.
* Provide caregiver education that focuses on identifying caregiver burnout, self\-care, resiliency, skills training and support group services.
* Track and maintain contact frequency based on program model and policy.
* Participate in monthly transdisciplinary meetings to collaborate and coordinate care effectively
* Provide accurate and efficient documentation for all interactions including the presenting issues, goal, intervention and action plan.
* Follow established company policies, procedures and clinical protocols and uphold Nolia's policy on client confidentiality.
* Represent Nolia Health at community events, health fairs, senior centers, and healthcare partner organizations, confidently educating stakeholders about our services and building relationships that generate referrals and community engagement.


**Experience/Skills:**
----------------------


* Preferably 2 years of experience working in a healthcare or community\-based setting.
* Ideally, 1 year of experience (professional or lived) in understanding the needs and challenges faced by family caregivers and older adults
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of cultural humility and the ability to communicate and effectively interact with individuals from diverse cultures, abilities, genders, ethnicities, and races.
* Experience working with Electronic Health Records (EHRs) a plus
* Ability to handle interactions with caregivers and patients involving heightened emotions.
* Strong general computer skills including the ability to navigate various different systems and resources, troubleshoot minor technology issues, and set\-up own work equipment.
* Attention to detail and effective time management and multi\-tasking skills
* Familiarity with healthcare industry, mental health, aging and disability services, or Alzheimer's disease
* Proficiency in another language, other than English, is a plus but not required.

**Benefits of being a part of the Nolia Care Team:**
----------------------------------------------------


* Nolia is an early stage startup committed to healthcare transformation. The opportunities to learn, grow and contribute to our mission are endless
* Various training programs, workshops, and resources are available to help you enhance your skills, knowledge, and expertise in the fields of caregiving and aging.
* We are focused on caregiving and this permeates our working culture. Most of our team have lived experiences as family caregivers. We prioritize your wellbeing and provide a flexible work schedule to accommodate other life responsibilities.
* This is a remote first position that allows for some scheduling flexibility.
* We prioritize inclusivity, teamwork, open communication, and mutual respect, fostering a positive work environment where you can excel and contribute to our shared goals

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Clinical Operations Specialist is an internal data and compliance analyst embedded within the Healthcare Center of Excellence (HCOE) Operations function at Strategic Education, Inc. This role serves as the primary owner of regulatory intelligence, state\-level approval tracking, accreditation data support, and operational reporting across all HCOE healthcare programs at Capella University and Strayer University.
   

Operating as a shared service, this role supports academic units at both institutions by maintaining the data infrastructure, dashboards, and reporting systems that enable the Assistant Dean for Operations, Executive Dean, Deans, program directors, accreditation leads, and senior leadership to make informed, timely decisions. This is a dedicated analytical and operational support position designed to reduce administrative burden on senior academic leaders while increasing the organization’s visibility into and responsiveness to regulatory change.**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Regulatory Intelligence**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve a 50\-state regulatory monitoring system covering all applicable state\-level approval requirements for HCOE healthcare programs, including but not limited to: BSN Pre\-Licensure, Associate Degree Nursing (ADN), LPN, Radiologic Technology, Respiratory Therapy, and Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) programs.
* Attend regulatory agency hearings, public comment sessions, or stakeholder convenings as directed by the ADO; prepare pre\-meeting briefings and post\-meeting summaries.
* Maintain an ongoing regulatory change log and issue tracker with status, owner, deadline, and risk level for each open item across all program types.
* Track state\-specific application requirements, processing timelines, and approval status for all pending or in\-progress program expansions across the full HCOE portfolio.

**Dashboard Development \& Data Reporting**

* Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports that provide real\-time visibility into regulatory status, state approval progress, clinical placement data, and accreditation timelines across all HCOE programs.
* Develop and own program\-specific State Approval Trackers as living operational tools — updating status categories, notes, and risk flags on a defined cadence. Produce standardized and ad hoc reports for multiple stakeholder audiences, including the ADO, Dean, program directors, Legal/Risk, Portfolio Strategy, and C\-suite leadership
* Build and maintain a clinical placement data repository tracking site\-level affiliation agreement status clinical hours capacity, and geographic footprint across all programs.
* Develop reporting pipelines that integrate data from multiple sources (Smartsheet, SharePoint, OneDrive, external agency websites) into cohesive operational views.
* Ensure all dashboards and trackers include version control, data source citations, and last\-updated timestamps for audit readiness.

**Accreditation and Clinical Operations Data Support**

* Support the maintenance of an accreditation standards mapping library that cross\-references applicable standards to program\-level evidence, documentation, and responsible owners within the academic units.
* Support academic unit leads in maintaining accreditation cycle timelines, self\-study due dates, site visit windows, and annual report deadlines across all accredited HCOE programs.
* Assist in organizing and compiling supporting evidence and data sets required for accreditation reports, site visit preparation, and interim monitoring submissions as directed.
* Support the ADO and academic unit stakeholders in maintaining clear documentation distinguishing HCOE program\-level approval status from institutional\-level regulatory approval status across reporting contexts.
* Provide data and reporting infrastructure that enables academic units at Capella and Strayer to meet their respective accreditation reporting obligations with accurate, readily retrievable information.
* Develop and maintain a library of templated reports tailored to distinct stakeholder groups: operational summaries for the ADO, executive briefings for C\-suite, program\-level detail for directors, and compliance\-focused summaries for Legal/Risk.
* Prepare presentation\-ready data outputs (slides, formatted tables).

**Job Skills:**

* Consultation: Serve as a university consultant to internal and external partners by providing data ready reports, tools and trackers.
* Collaboration: Partner with university and system leaders to integrate academic priorities with institutional and system‑wide goals.
* Data Visualization: Translate complex regulatory and compliance data into clear, audience\-appropriate formats: executive summaries, status tables, heatmaps, gap analyses, and risk matrices.
* Synthesis of Data: Able to synthesize large inputs of data and turn into concise documents for a broad audience.
* Strong prioritizations skills that are able to balance competing high priority projects.
* High degree of self\-direction and comfort operating in a matrixed, remote\-first environment.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, particularly in regulatory tracking and compliance documentation.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to convey complex issues in a concise and clear manner.
* Displayed business acumen and enterprise awareness.

**Work Experience:**

* Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in a regulatory, compliance, accreditation, academic operations, or healthcare data analyst role required.
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards, trackers, or reporting tools strongly preferred (Excel, Smartsheet, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* Experience working in higher education, healthcare regulation, or a multi\-site/multi\-state compliance environment strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with nursing education and allied health regulatory frameworks, including state board of n

Ideal candidates will have a successful track record in territory development and demonstrated sales results. This Account Manager position is an ideal opportunity for individuals who demonstrate the ability to effectively manage work independently and have the ability to travel (around or above 50%).

* Working independently to develop new leads and opportunities
* Supporting distribution representatives
Acting as a resource to customers and distributor representatives for product and company knowledge  
*

* Bachelor's Degree required (Biology or Life Sciences preferred)

Must have valid driver’s license

Compensation range 100,000\-125,000 base and 50,000\-65,000 incentive target (uncapped) plus car allowance. Full benefits package plus 401k with corporate match.

At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our purpose; to advance science and technology to enable a healthier and more connected world for everyone, everywhere. jobs.description:
**Position Summary**:


The Pharmacy Operations Lead Rep operates as a Client Support/Support Shift Lead TSS and is the first line contact for our current and future Essentials and Optimizer clients with any questions and/or issues regarding PowerGridRx (PGRX). The SSL exhibits teaching leadership and oversees continuity of care and service to our clients and staff. The SSL will also act as the first line contact for any issues regarding internal issues, such as I.T., team coverage issues, etc.

**Position Description**:


The Support Shift Lead (SSL) will triage client, pharmacist, and TSS connectivity or PowerGridRx problems. In addition to completing the duties outlined in the TSS job description, the SSL will be first contact for all clients, pharmacists, and/or TSS experiencing PGRX issues. The SSL will also be responsible for making day to day shift changes in assignments to optimize productivity.


**Performance Objectives and Responsibilities**:

* Triaging Client PGRX questions/issues to the best of their capability
* Creating Zendesk tickets and following through with them, when required
* Directing the client to the correct point of contact, when required
* Successfully provide TSS staffing services
* Clinical Support


	+ Assist with TSS training and understanding on intervention documentation.
	+ Train the TSS and Pharmacist staff to understand the Intervention notes and Parked orders notes.
* Operation Support


	+ Assist with managing the PipelineRx queue by posting orders to the appropriate pharmacist on duty.
	+ Monitor queues to assist pharmacists in decreasing turnaround time.
	+ Optimize pharmacy workflow by contacting clients on behalf of the on\-duty pharmacist to minimize time away from orders.
	
	
	Monitor and triage phone calls from high volume call clients, if needed. Assist in answering phone calls during peak hours.
	+ Utilize guidelines from the Phone Tree to:
	
	
	Ensure the pharmacist on duty always has visibility to the assigned clients. Call client’s IT or PipelineRx IT for support on behalf of the pharmacist on duty for advanced technology issues to be resolved.
	
	
	Ensure all clients have pharmacist coverage during PipelineRx contractual shift hours.
	
	
	Initiate procedures to coordinate pharmacist coverage during emergencies such as: no\-show, call off, sick call, power or internet outage, etc. as established by TSS Manager in conjunction with Pharmacist Supervisor.
* Communication


	+ Facilitate pharmacist communication with clients when access to the client’s system is interrupted during the Pipeline shift.
	+ Maintain accurate records of interactions and issues by providing a nightly report of activities during your shift to TSS manager.
	+ Establish yourself as a valuable resource to the pharmacist on duty for any issues or concerns during a shift.

**Qualifications and Requirements**:

* Possession of high school diploma; bachelor’s degree, preferred,
* Current National Certification and State license, required
* 1\+ year experience as an institutional pharmacy technician
* Strong IT and troubleshooting experience, including using a ticketing system such as Zendesk,
* Proficiency with office technology tools, including Microsoft Office (especially Outlook, Excel, and Word), Google Drive, internet, and email,
* Able to work efficiently and independently,
* Able to switch from one responsibility to another without it affecting customer service,
* Available for emergency assistance,
* Exceptional interpersonal and customer service skills.

**Physical Demands:**

* May sit, stand, stoop, bend, and walk intermittently during the day.
* Finger dexterity to operate office equipment required.
* May need to lift up to twenty\-five (25\) pounds on occasion.
* Specific vision abilities required by this role include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
* Visual acuity to see and read fine prints.
* Must be able to hear normal voice sounds.
* This role requires typical office\-based physical activities: watching a computer monitor, use of a keyboard, occasionally repositioning light desk equipment, and speaking on a telephone for extended periods of time.

**Work Environment**:

  

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* IT secure office environment that is fully compliant with HIPAA, ARRA/HITECH, Federal and State regulations.
* Work performed in an office setting, with occasional travel for meetings in hospitals or other office settings.

*The above job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required for the position.*

  


If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.
For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly rate of 21 \- 31 USD / hourly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Pharmacy Technician with retail pharmacy experience to make a positive impact in the lives of the patients we care for, working with a devoted pharmacy operations team. **Our Company**
We're VytlOne and we're building a different kind of pharmacy company. We're transforming the pharmacy industry to create healthier lives through purposeful engagement across Pharmacy Benefit Management, Pharmacy Management, Specialty Pharmacy, 340B, Rebate and Formulary Management, and Pharmacies. We put people first and are committed to providing outstanding service across all aspects of our business. We believe there's a better way to deliver pharmacy and healthcare services to people across the country, and we'd love for you to help us do it. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS APPLICABLE TO ALL ROLES/DUTIES:**

*(This document in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position)*

* Obtains copy of prescription drug card to be filed in the electronic chart
* Ensures the accuracy of all patient demographic information in the pharmacy system.
* Sets up patient copay assistance and foundation support when necessary.
* Works orders daily to ensure the most efficient turnaround time; keeps patients, prescribers and sales team (if needed) abreast of any issues or delays in treatment.

* Obtains method of payment from each patient for any financial obligation owed by the patient and loads the information into CPR\+ for future use.
* Completes accurate dates on each delivery ticket and makes the shipment ‘Ready to Fill’.
* Sends status update word merge documents to prescriber as needed.
* Answer incoming calls as assigned and as transferred
* Responsible for managing the following Ques in the SPRX list:
	+ - Claims to Adjudicate – New Rx’s
		- Benefits Verification – New Rx’s
	+ - Patients to Contact – New Rx’s
		- Patients to Contact – New Rx’s
* **WORK SCHEDULE:**


	+ Monday through Friday, 8 hour shifts during regular pharmacy hours
	+ Additional hours as required
	+ Rotating on call responsibilities may be required

 **Education*** High School diploma or equivalency
* Registered/Certified Pharmacy Technician preferred

**Experience*** One \- two year’s relevant experience.
* Any combination of the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities.

 **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Working knowledge of computer software, specifically Microsoft Office and Outlook
* Ability to accurately enter data into a computer system
* Ability to prioritize work to meet deadlines
* Ability to multi\-task and work accurately under pressure
* Ability to work through and solve problems independently
* Positive attitude, innovative, self\-starter

Drive innovation in enablement practices and technology, leveraging adult learning principles, behavioral science, and emerging tools (including AI) to enhance scalability, engagement, and measurable behavior change.

Requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience; or a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience.  
Experience delivering enablement for client\-facing GTM teams (Sales and Client Success essential).  
Experience implementing learning analytics dashboards and continuous improvement loops to measure impact and optimize enablement.

Excellent business partner and collaborator management, communication, and influence skills, able to align senior cross\-functional leaders and translate business priorities into effective learning strategies.  
Proven knowledge of adult learning principles, inclusive and accessible design, and modern learning technologies (e.g., LMS/LXP and authoring/simulation tools such as Synthesia, Elucidat, SmartBuilder, Vyond).

Are you a natural people leader who knows how to build community, inspire service, and help volunteers feel valued? Valley Humane Society is looking for an experienced and energetic **Volunteer Program Manager** to lead and strengthen a corps of more than 200 volunteers who support our animals, programs, and mission.



This is a people\-first leadership role for someone who enjoys coaching, public speaking, problem\-solving, and hands\-on program management. You will oversee the volunteer experience from recruitment and onboarding through training, recognition, retention, and, when necessary, difficult performance conversations. You will also partner closely with shelter and program teams to ensure volunteer support meets real operational needs.

 **About Valley Humane Society:**



Valley Humane Society is a private, nonprofit animal welfare organization incorporated in 1987 with an excellent reputation for quality care and community support. Envisioning a world in which every animal is loved and every person knows the love of an animal, the organization creates a brighter future for cats and dogs by encouraging and strengthening the bond between people and pets. Valley Humane Society is an equal opportunity employer; the team is guided by the values of Compassion, Companionship, Optimism, Gratitude, Collaboration, and Integrity.



Valley Humane Society is located in beautiful Pleasanton, CA, nestled among rolling hills and close to the Livermore Valley Wine Country. The area boasts year\-round recreation, top\-rated schools, and a vibrant sense of community. Visit valleyhumane.org to learn more.

 **Responsibilities Owned by This Role Include:**


* Leading, coaching, and mentoring a corps of more than 200 volunteers
* Managing recruitment, onboarding, training, recognition, retention, and volunteer communications
* Delivering engaging orientations and ongoing training for groups of all sizes
* Providing constructive feedback and handling conflict or performance concerns with empathy and professionalism
* Partnering with Operations and program leaders to align volunteer scheduling and training with organizational needs
* Representing the volunteer program at community events, speaking engagements, and outreach activities
* Tracking volunteer coverage, retention, satisfaction, attendance, and pipeline health
* Improving volunteer systems, processes, and engagement strategies through data and experimentation

  


**Basic Requirements:**


* 3\+ years of experience in people management, volunteer management, human resources, or a related coaching or leadership role
* Strong public speaking, facilitation, coaching, and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to manage sensitive conversations and provide clear, constructive feedback

Full time with benefits

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . In the Division of Student Affairs and under the Residential Student Services Programs portfolio, Berkeley Dining is a self\-operated dining program focused on culinary excellence, social responsibility and supporting the living/learning environment of our customers.

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large\-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and power in renewable\-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
  

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high\-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
  

  

We are hiring a Business Operations Manager to run the business of Cloud Operations and SRE, and to work 1:1 with the VP who leads it. One role, two halves that reinforce each other: you own how the org plans, reports and follows through, and you own the executive’s time, attention and follow\-through as a system you design and continuously improve.
  

  

We are looking for someone who already runs their own stack of agents and automations, who treats “a human did this manually” as a bug, and who measures themselves by what moved forward — not by what got scheduled.
  

  

If you have been the person on your team quietly building the workflows everyone else asks to borrow, read on.
  

  

What This Role Actually Is
  

* A business operations owner. You run the planning and reporting spine of the org: goals and OKRs, the roadmap, the cross\-functional programs, and the metrics that say whether Cloud Operations and SRE are healthy. You know the numbers before anyone asks for them, and you chase down the ones that do not make sense.
* A program driver. For initiatives that cross teams, you own the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the uncomfortable status update. Nobody should have to ask “what happened with that?”
* An operator. You will run the operating cadence: staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles, offsites. You will run these end to end: agenda, pre\-reads, decisions captured, owners assigned, follow\-ups driven to closure.
* A force multiplier to the executive, not a filter. The executive support half of this job is a core part of it, not a legacy attachment. You will own the VP’s calendar, inbox, travel and follow\-through, and you will make decisions on their behalf inside clearly defined boundaries widening those boundaries as trust compounds. You understand what good looks like for implementing an agentic stack to be the filter, and the organizational change management necessary to drive the teams to that filter.
* An org operations partner. Headcount and requisition tracking, hiring loops, onboarding that does not depend on tribal knowledge, team communications, and offsites you own outright.
* An automation builder. Every recurring task you touch is a candidate for an agent. Weekly reports, status roll\-ups, meeting prep briefs, inbox triage and drafting, travel logistics, expense reconciliation, doc hygiene — you build it once, monitor it, and move on to the next thing. Your job is to work yourself out of your own to\-do list, repeatedly. There is plenty more to do after all of this is automated; it is why you are a force multiplier and an operator.
* A judgment layer. Automation is cheap; taste is not. You will know which emails only the executive can answer, which meeting genuinely needs 60 minutes, which “urgent” request can wait until Thursday, and which agent output is subtly wrong and must never go out the door.

  
* 5 or more years in business operations, program management, chief\-of\-staff or senior executive support roles, including direct experience supporting a senior executive, and at least some of it in a fast\-moving, high\-ambiguity environment (startup, scale\-up, or a team inside a larger company operating like one).
* Genuinely AI\-native. You use AI assistants and agentic tools every day, not occasionally. You can describe — in specifics — a workflow you automated, what broke, and how you fixed it. Prompting is not a party trick to you; it is how you work. Bonus points if you are well beyond prompting and operating with context and graph loop engineering.
* Hands\-on with agentic tooling. Personal AI agents and assistants for calendar, inbox and scheduling; general\-purpose assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) as daily drivers; and connective tissue between systems. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be unafraid of documentation and have a high level of taste.
* The ability to run a cadence and a program. Agendas, pre\-reads, decision logs, status that is honest when it is bad. You are comfortable holding senior people to commitments they made, in writing, in front of their peers.
* Comfort with numbers. You can build a reporting roll\-up, spot the metric that is lying, and explain a trend to leadership without dressing it up.
* Judgment under incomplete information, or with swinging\-door outcomes. You would rather make a reversible decision now than wait for permission.
* Instinctive discretion. You will sit close to board material, compensation, org changes and unannounced strategy. This is table stakes.

  

Nice to have:
  

* You have built something small and useful with low\-code tools — a script, a dashboard, a bot — because it was faster than asking.
* You have run a planning or OKR cycle for a technical org and lived with the result.
* You have been given scope beyond a traditional remit: a project, a budget, a vendor relationship, a team offsite you owned outright.

* You know how to speak clanker.

**Company Description**:


Axis Community Health, a nonprofit established in 1972, provides comprehensive healthcare services to over 15,000 individuals across all age groups in the Tri\-Valley area. The mission of Axis Community Health is to provide quality, affordable, accessible and compassionate health care services that promote the well\-being of all members of the community.




Our mission is rooted in delivering high\-quality patient care, encompassing primary healthcare, mental health support, and dental services. We are committed to ensuring access to essential healthcare services for every member of our community, irrespective of financial status, living situation, or insurance coverage.




**Job Summary:**


The Clinical Care Assistant is a medical assistant whose primary role is to assist the nursing team in communication with patients and other health care systems to better coordinate patient care. This role will also involve hands\-on care with appropriate level patient visits such as ear lavage, EKGs, and other assigned duties. The ideal candidate will have a high school diploma, one (1\) year of experience in a healthcare setting, and a current certification as a medical assistant.




**Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent is required.
* Minimum of one (1\) year of experience as a medical assistant in a healthcare setting is preferred.
* Current valid certification as a Medical Assistant is required.
* EPIC experience is a plus.
* Excellent telephone and patient service skills.
* Knowledge of patient billing procedures and insurance verification.
* Ability to work efficiently and effectively.
* Ability to work well under pressure, multi\-task and handles stress well.
* English/Spanish bilingual is required.
* Strong analytical, employee relations, and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent writing, business communication, editing, and proofreading skills.

* Ability to establish and maintain positive and professional working relationships.

* Must be able to be at work regularly and on time.
* Must be a dynamic self\-starter with demonstrated ability to work independently or in a group setting.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Follow Axis workflows in Epic and ensure all medical documentation is completed promptly and accurately.
* Assist RNs with translation when needed.
* Schedule patient appointments, follow\-up visits, and work with internal and external teams to ensure referrals and orders are completed.

* Assist patients with understanding and navigating their healthcare options and services.
* Greet patients and agency visitors and direct all individuals to the appropriate location and services. Be courteous, polite and helpful to the public and clients at all times when representing the organization.
* Respect and maintain privacy and dignity of agency clients and assure client confidentiality per HIPAA regulations.
* Assist patients in accurately completing appropriate forms, and document all information according to Axis Community Health protocols.

* Perform injections under the supervision of a Medical Provider or Registered Nurse.

* Prepare the clinical area prior to the start of each clinic.
* Participate in staff meetings, attend other meeting and training events as assigned.
* May be required to perform other related duties, responsibilities and special projects as assigned.




**Benefits:**

* Employer paid health, dental, and vision benefits to the employee.
* Option to participate in a 403(B) retirement plan with employer matching contribution.
* Partial educational reimbursement.
* 12 paid holidays.

The Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) and Power Generation (PGEN) Team, under the Applications and Operations organization, supports the applications that enable the people and processes that work in Energy Procurement, Market and Credit Risk Management, and Power Generation. These applications enable our business partners to transact gas and power on behalf of California customers through the CAISO market, energy exchanges, and supplier contracts.
  
  

These systems allow our business partners to securely transact gas and power through the CAISO market, energy exchanges, and supplier contracts, ensuring PG\&E can meet customer demand every day. At the same time, these solutions provide strong market and credit risk controls that protect customers from unnecessary financial exposure and help keep energy costs stable and predictable. Interacting with different groups and systems in support of open requests or work. **Job Title:** Remote Home Health Interdisciplinary QA Specialist, Therapy \& MSW Documentation  
**Company:** Allegro Home Health  
**Location:** Remote  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Part\-Time, or Contract  
**Pay:** Competitive, based on experience

About Allegro Home Health

Allegro Home Health is a growing Medicare\-certified home health agency serving the San Francisco Bay Area. We are committed to delivering high\-quality patient care while maintaining strong Medicare compliance, clinical documentation integrity, and consistent support for our field clinicians.

We are seeking an experienced **Remote Home Health Interdisciplinary QA Specialist** with strong knowledge of home health documentation, Medicare requirements, therapy documentation, Medical Social Work documentation, OASIS, CMS 485 Plans of Care, and Kinnser/WellSky.

This is an individual contributor role, not a director\-level position. The focus is hands\-on quality assurance review, documentation feedback, and practical clinician education.

Position Summary

The Home Health Interdisciplinary QA Specialist will review clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, compliance, and consistency with Medicare home health requirements. This role will focus heavily on **Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Speech Therapy, Medical Social Work, CMS 485 Plans of Care, OASIS consistency, physician orders, visit frequencies, skilled need, homebound support, and interdisciplinary chart review**.

The ideal candidate understands how therapy and MSW documentation must support skilled need, medical necessity, homebound status, patient\-specific goals, care coordination, and Medicare billing compliance. This person should be able to identify documentation gaps and provide clear, practical feedback to clinicians without being overly rigid or unrealistic.

Experience with **Kinnser/WellSky** is strongly preferred.

Key ResponsibilitiesInterdisciplinary Clinical QA \& Chart Review

* Conduct QA reviews of patient records from admission through discharge.
* Review documentation from multiple home health disciplines, including:
* Physical Therapy
* Occupational Therapy
* Speech Therapy
* Medical Social Work
* Skilled Nursing
* Home Health Aides
* Ensure documentation is accurate, complete, cohesive, clinically appropriate, and compliant with Medicare home health requirements.
* Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance risks before billing submission.
* Ensure consistency among referral records, physician orders, OASIS assessments, CMS 485 Plans of Care, therapy evaluations, MSW evaluations, visit notes, reassessments, recertifications, and discharge documentation.
* Validate that documentation supports skilled need, medical necessity, homebound status, and continued eligibility for home health services.
* Provide clear, practical, and professional feedback to clinicians regarding documentation corrections and improvement opportunities.

PT, OT \& ST Documentation QA

* Review Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Speech Therapy evaluations, reassessments, progress notes, visit notes, and discharge documentation.
* Ensure therapy documentation supports Medicare coverage requirements and skilled intervention.
* Verify that therapy documentation clearly supports:
* Functional deficits
* Fall risk and safety concerns
* ADL and IADL limitations
* Gait, balance, strength, endurance, transfers, mobility, swallowing, communication, cognition, or safety needs as applicable
* Patient\-specific measurable goals
* Skilled interventions provided
* Treatment progression or clinical reason for lack of progress
* Caregiver training and response
* Continued skilled need
* Discharge readiness or need for continued services
* Review therapy frequencies and durations for clinical appropriateness and consistency with the CMS 485 Plan of Care.
* Review therapy recertification documentation to ensure continued skilled need and homebound status are clearly supported.
* Identify generic or weak therapy documentation and provide correction guidance that is practical for field clinicians.
* Support documentation improvement for maintenance therapy, functional decline, fall risk, caregiver training, and continued skilled need.

Medical Social Work Documentation QA

* Review Medical Social Work evaluations, visit notes, care coordination documentation, resource planning, and discharge documentation.
* Ensure MSW documentation supports the need for skilled social work intervention during the home health episode.
* Verify that MSW documentation clearly reflects:
* Psychosocial barriers affecting care
* Patient and caregiver support needs
* Community resource needs
* Safety concerns
* Financial, transportation, housing, food, medication access, or caregiving barriers when applicable
* Advance care planning, long\-term planning, or placement concerns when applicable
* Coordination with family, caregivers, community agencies, physicians, and the interdisciplinary team
* Patient/caregiver response to MSW intervention
* Clear plan for follow\-up or discharge from MSW services
* Ensure MSW services are connected to the patient’s home health Plan of Care and are not documented as generic social support only.
* Provide practical feedback to MSW clinicians on Medicare\-compliant documentation and patient\-specific care planning.

OASIS \& CMS 485 Plan of Care Review

* Review OASIS assessments for consistency with the clinical record, especially functional status, therapy needs, cognitive status, safety risk, caregiver support, and discharge status.
* Review CMS 485 Plans of Care for accuracy, completeness, clinical appropriateness, and Medicare compliance.
* Ensure the Plan of Care supports diagnoses, skilled services, visit frequencies, interventions, measurable goals, homebound status, and discharge planning.
* Ensure OASIS findings, therapy needs, nursing needs, MSW needs, physician orders, and the CMS 485 Plan of Care are consistent.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Clinical Operations Specialist is an internal data and compliance analyst embedded within the Healthcare Center of Excellence (HCOE) Operations function at Strategic Education, Inc. This role serves as the primary owner of regulatory intelligence, state\-level approval tracking, accreditation data support, and operational reporting across all HCOE healthcare programs at Capella University and Strayer University.
   

Operating as a shared service, this role supports academic units at both institutions by maintaining the data infrastructure, dashboards, and reporting systems that enable the Assistant Dean for Operations, Executive Dean, Deans, program directors, accreditation leads, and senior leadership to make informed, timely decisions. This is a dedicated analytical and operational support position designed to reduce administrative burden on senior academic leaders while increasing the organization’s visibility into and responsiveness to regulatory change.
**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Regulatory Intelligence**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve a 50\-state regulatory monitoring system covering all applicable state\-level approval requirements for HCOE healthcare programs, including but not limited to: BSN Pre\-Licensure, Associate Degree Nursing (ADN), LPN, Radiologic Technology, Respiratory Therapy, and Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) programs.
* Attend regulatory agency hearings, public comment sessions, or stakeholder convenings as directed by the ADO; prepare pre\-meeting briefings and post\-meeting summaries.
* Maintain an ongoing regulatory change log and issue tracker with status, owner, deadline, and risk level for each open item across all program types.
* Track state\-specific application requirements, processing timelines, and approval status for all pending or in\-progress program expansions across the full HCOE portfolio.

**Dashboard Development \& Data Reporting**

* Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports that provide real\-time visibility into regulatory status, state approval progress, clinical placement data, and accreditation timelines across all HCOE programs.
* Develop and own program\-specific State Approval Trackers as living operational tools — updating status categories, notes, and risk flags on a defined cadence. Produce standardized and ad hoc reports for multiple stakeholder audiences, including the ADO, Dean, program directors, Legal/Risk, Portfolio Strategy, and C\-suite leadership
* Build and maintain a clinical placement data repository tracking site\-level affiliation agreement status clinical hours capacity, and geographic footprint across all programs.
* Develop reporting pipelines that integrate data from multiple sources (Smartsheet, SharePoint, OneDrive, external agency websites) into cohesive operational views.
* Ensure all dashboards and trackers include version control, data source citations, and last\-updated timestamps for audit readiness.

**Accreditation and Clinical Operations Data Support**

* Support the maintenance of an accreditation standards mapping library that cross\-references applicable standards to program\-level evidence, documentation, and responsible owners within the academic units.
* Support academic unit leads in maintaining accreditation cycle timelines, self\-study due dates, site visit windows, and annual report deadlines across all accredited HCOE programs.
* Assist in organizing and compiling supporting evidence and data sets required for accreditation reports, site visit preparation, and interim monitoring submissions as directed.
* Support the ADO and academic unit stakeholders in maintaining clear documentation distinguishing HCOE program\-level approval status from institutional\-level regulatory approval status across reporting contexts.
* Provide data and reporting infrastructure that enables academic units at Capella and Strayer to meet their respective accreditation reporting obligations with accurate, readily retrievable information.
* Develop and maintain a library of templated reports tailored to distinct stakeholder groups: operational summaries for the ADO, executive briefings for C\-suite, program\-level detail for directors, and compliance\-focused summaries for Legal/Risk.
* Prepare presentation\-ready data outputs (slides, formatted tables).

**Job Skills:**

* Consultation: Serve as a university consultant to internal and external partners by providing data ready reports, tools and trackers.
* Collaboration: Partner with university and system leaders to integrate academic priorities with institutional and system‑wide goals.
* Data Visualization: Translate complex regulatory and compliance data into clear, audience\-appropriate formats: executive summaries, status tables, heatmaps, gap analyses, and risk matrices.
* Synthesis of Data: Able to synthesize large inputs of data and turn into concise documents for a broad audience.
* Strong prioritizations skills that are able to balance competing high priority projects.
* High degree of self\-direction and comfort operating in a matrixed, remote\-first environment.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, particularly in regulatory tracking and compliance documentation.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to convey complex issues in a concise and clear manner.
* Displayed business acumen and enterprise awareness.

**Work Experience:**

* Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in a regulatory, compliance, accreditation, academic operations, or healthcare data analyst role required.
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards, trackers, or reporting tools strongly preferred (Excel, Smartsheet, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* Experience working in higher education, healthcare regulation, or a multi\-site/multi\-state compliance environment strongly preferred.

Quality Coding Software Solutions (QCSS) is seeking a Customer Success Support Manager to lead our Support Desk function supporting Managed Care and Community\-Based Healthcare clients. This role is responsible for overseeing the Support team, while ensuring exceptional support experiences for all health plan end users. We offer an exciting opportunity to support health care insurers and providers in improving health care outcomes for vulnerable populations. Our solutions positively impact over two hundred fifty thousand health plan members.


The Customer Success Support Manager serves as the operational owner of the support experience, support processes, SLA performance, and cross\-functional collaboration. This role requires a customer\-focused leader who can balance strategic planning with operational execution while working closely with Customer Success, Product, Technology, Implementation, and Executive Leadership teams.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead and manage the day\-to\-day support desk operations, ensuring timely, high\-quality support across all client health plans.
* Own support performance, including response times, resolution times, SLA compliance, and overall service quality.
* Serve as the escalation point for the Support team for customer issues and critical incidents.

new_jobs.description:
### **About Aegis Ventures**


**Aegis Ventures** is a next\-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The Aegis platform brings together market\-shaping ideas, permanent growth capital, and ambitious individuals who are driven to solve major societal problems. Our companies use technology to transform healthcare by dramatically improving quality, access, and cost. Aegis creates new companies with substantial input from our Digital Consortium of a dozen leading health systems and other ecosystem partners. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.


### **About the Company**


**Optain** is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking software and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we detect and manage eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through the introduction of AI and machine learning technology in frontline care settings at an accessible price. This not only promotes greater access to care, but promises to reduce the strains of overburdened healthcare systems.



Originally founded in Australia in 2019, Optain seeks to commercialize the inventions of Professor Mingguang He, a preeminent clinician\-scientist and scholar in the field of ophthalmology. Optain has achieved regulatory approval and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, Europe, and more.



In 2025, Optain received US FDA clearance for its Resolve retinal camera. Optain also recently closed a Series A funding round led by Insight Partners with participation from seven leading U.S. health system investors, including Memorial Hermann Health System, Northwell Health, Novant Health, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and UPMC. These systems collectively deliver care to 28 million patients across 25 states and have begun deploying Optain's platform across their networks, rapidly accelerating the company's footprint and expanding screening access nationwide.


### **About the Job**



As the **Product Operations and Support Specialist**, you will be the escalation point for customers using Optain’s robotic retinal camera and supporting software. Because our product is a tightly integrated hardware\-software medical device deployed in live clinical settings, you will troubleshoot issues that span device hardware, image capture software, image quality, connectivity, EHR integrations, and downstream teleophthalmology grading workflows. In the U.S., Optain pairs its FDA\-cleared Resolve camera with rapid teleophthalmology grading; in international markets, Optain offers AI\-enabled Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) for screening common eye diseases and cardiovascular risk.



This is a high\-ownership, U.S.\-based remote role on a growing product team, reporting to the VP of Product. Beyond hands\-on Tier 2 support, issue investigation, and medical device complaint handling, you will enable our Customer Support team, feed real\-world signal back to the Product team, and own the internal operations, tooling, and projects that make the Product and Support teams more effective.


### **What You'll Do**


* Serve as Tier 2 support for customers who escalate device feedback, complaints, and semi\-technical product issues; reproducing, diagnosing, and resolving problems across the hardware\-software boundary, distinguishing camera or hardware faults from software, image\-quality, connectivity, EHR\-integration, or user technique issues.
* Capture, document, and route device feedback and complaints in line with Optain’s quality management system and applicable regulations (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR), recognizing when feedback may constitute a reportable complaint or potential adverse event and escalating appropriately to Quality and Regulatory.
* Support the Customer Success team with semi\-technical product and onboarding questions, acting as the bridge between front\-line CS and Engineering support. Contribute to knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and training resources that enable CS to resolve more issues independently.
* Own internal operations and projects for the product team, including specifying requirements for internal support tooling, improving support and complaint\-handling workflows, and coordinating cross\-functional projects from intake to delivery.
* Support Quality in tracking and analyzing support and complaint trends, translate recurring problems into prioritized product improvement recommendations, and serve as a voice of the customer within the product organization.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Customer Success to ensure issues are resolved quickly while meeting the documentation rigor required of a regulated medical device.

### **What You'll Need**


* 3\+ years in technical support, product support, application support, or product operations for software as a medical device (SaMD), or combined hardware software medical device product.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across hardware\-software boundaries, isolating whether a problem originates in a hardware device, software, image quality, connectivity, or user technique. Ability to reproduce issues occurring on equipment at a remote customer site.
* Familiarity working within a quality management system and complaint\-handling processes in a regulated environment (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR, ISO 13485, or EU MDR), including an understanding of when an issue may be a reportable complaint or adverse event.
* Strong written communication, with a track record of building knowledge base articles, runbooks, or training that enables less\-technical teammates to resolve issues independently. Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technic
